test_title: PYST 20: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Worker X and Worker Y can complete a specific project in 56 days and 70 days, respectively. They begin the project together, but Worker X leaves after several days, and Worker Y finishes the remaining work in 34 days. How many days did Worker X work before leaving?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by X = 56 days

Time taken by Y = 70 days

Time Y worked alone to finish = 34 days

**Formula used:**

Total Work = LCM of time taken

Efficiency = Total Work / Time

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let total work = LCM(56, 70) = 280 units

⇒ Efficiency of X = 280 / 56 = 5 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of Y = 280 / 70 = 4 units/day

⇒ Work done by Y alone in 34 days = 4 × 34 = 136 units

⇒ Remaining work done by X and Y together = 280 - 136 = 144 units

⇒ Combined efficiency of X and Y = 5 + 4 = 9 units/day

⇒ Number of days X and Y worked together = 144 / 9

⇒ 16 days

**∴ Worker X worked for 16 days before leaving.**
